text.description_html:
Acorn RIKBP, 19-7/8" Heart Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle

The 19-7/8 Inch Heart Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle has a rough iron finish which duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron. Its functionality does not overlook appearance. It is designed for gates 3 to 4 inches thick up to up to 250 lbs. This Acorn made iron strap hinge will be sure to add an authentic old world finishing touch to any door. Comes packaged with carriage bolts.

Also Available Matching: 17" Heart Tip Rough Iron Strap Hinge With Carriage Bolt

Features of the 19-7/8" Heart Tip Strap Hinge:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish carriage bolts.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Acorn Rough Iron Heart Tip 19-7/8" Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Designed for gates 3" to 4" inches thick up to up to 250 lbs.
  • Length: 19-7/8"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • Gauge: .187
  • Pintle: 5-1/2"

Sold Individually
